cases.name: etaf-posframe-rejects-invalid-options
cases.purpose: Unknown options, non-positive sizes, unsupported dismissal and anchors signal etaf-posframe-error with the offending option named.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-theme-returns-frame-colors
cases.purpose: A panel Theme derives every catalog token as an #RRGGBB color from the current frame.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-live-p-rejects-non-panels
cases.purpose: Lifecycle predicates accept only live panel objects and an empty panel list reports no panels.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-show-owns-panel-lifecycle
cases.purpose: Showing a View mounts one panel and hiding it releases the panel, its Runtime and its frame.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-toggle-hides-the-open-panel
cases.purpose: The toggle entry hides the current buffer's open panel instead of stacking a second one.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-show-replaces-the-buffer-panel
cases.purpose: A second show for the same buffer replaces the earlier panel instead of stacking two.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-timeout-closes-the-panel
cases.purpose: A panel with :timeout hides by itself and releases its Runtime.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-focusable-panel-takes-and-restores-focus
cases.purpose: A focusable panel selects itself on open and returns focus to the previous frame on hide.

cases.name: etaf-posframe-killing-the-parent-buffer-closes-the-panel
cases.purpose: The panel owns a kill-buffer hook in its parent buffer, so killing that buffer releases the panel.
